name: A Grim Discovery
label: Quest
description: Krueg Skullsplitter admits to having mentioned a bounty, and says the one who did the work deserves the best of the payoff. The horns are put in a crate…
intro: Krueg Skullsplitter admits to having mentioned a bounty, and says the one who did the work deserves the best of the payoff. The horns are put in a crate for you to carry to Belgrom Rockmaul, found in the Valley of Honor in Orgrimmar, who will want your account. This follows the first A Grim Discovery.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Ah, so I did mention a bounty, didn't I? Well, that'll teach me to open my mouth, won't it?

You did the work, so I suppose it is only right you reap the greatest reward from it. Take the horns, I'll have them put in a crate for you. Find Belgrom Rockmaul in the Valley of Honor, he'll want to know what you saw and he'll reward you for your hard work.
Be well, adventurer, and thank you again for everything you've done.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Be quick, adventurer, I have much to complete today.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The Grimtotem!? This is interesting. You say you came across them while hunting in Feralas? Truly?
My peers will want to hear your news, adventurer. Tell me more and I'll count out your coin while you do so.
And before you go, know that I give you thanks for the information you've passed on to me this day.
